purpose: Backend-owned, user-led chat-first AI meeting, exact bounded AI-turn batches, proposal, and explicit approval contract for visible Agent HQ collaboration.

endpoints.GET /api/meetings/sessions: List bounded frontend-safe meeting session summaries without running an Agent or creating a Mission.
endpoints.GET /api/meetings/sessions/{id}: Read one exact frontend-safe meeting session, transcript, current proposal, approval state, and separately linked implementation Mission id.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions: Require agenda, developmentGoal, aiTurnsPerRound, and idempotencyKey; create one bounded discussion session and start exactly one user-requested AI-turn batch backed by one low-risk discussion_only agent_collaboration Mission. It does not expose the project Workspace, create an implementation/code Mission, or approve implementation.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions/{id}/message: Append one durable user interjection only while awaiting_user, then start exactly one next AI-turn batch using the session aiTurnsPerRound. The interjection is never inserted into an already-running batch and never counts as an AI turn; discussion remains tool-free and Workspace-free.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions/{id}/proposa: Freeze the current Manager proposal and compute its canonical SHA-256 proposalDigest. This endpoint creates no Mission and grants no implementation authority.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions/{id}/approve: Accept one fresh explicit local-user confirmation bound to the exact meetingId and current proposalDigest, then create one separate approval-bound implementation Mission. It never executes that Mission in the approval request.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions/{id}/reject: Reject the exact current proposalDigest without creating or executing a Mission. A later proposal is a new revision requiring a new explicit decision.

developmentGoal.meaning: Concrete product or workflow outcome the user wants the AI meeting to improve; discussion and the final Manager decision must stay within this goal.

aiTurnsPerRound.meaning: Exact number of AI turns in every completed batch. It is configured separately from participant-pool size, but may not be lower than the distinct selected Specialists plus the required Manager.

session_read_model.aiTurnsPerRound: exact integer from two through eight for every completed AI-turn batch
participantAgentIds: one to three Backend-owned specialist Agent ids followed by manager
session_read_model.activeDiscussionMissionId: current or latest discussion Mission id
session_read_model.implementationMission: frontend-safe Mission status and approval summary or null
session_read_model.readyToExecute: true only when session is approved and the separate Mission approval is complete
session_read_model.approvalNote: the bounded local-user implementation boundary persisted after approval, or null
session_read_model.managerDecision: frontend-safe latest Manager decision or null

chat_first_workflow.initialBatchTrigger: One accepted create-session request containing explicit agenda, developmentGoal, and aiTurnsPerRound.
chat_first_workflow.nextBatchTrigger: One accepted durable user interjection while the session is awaiting_user.

ai_turn_batch_schema.specialistSelectionRule: Fill the first aiTurnsPerRound-1 slots by cycling deterministically through participantAgentIds excluding manager; repeat specialists when more slots than specialists are selected.

turn_schema.proposal: bounded proposal or null for user
acceptanceChecks: zero to four bounded measurable checks
turn_schema.managerDecision: bounded decision object or null for user

proposal_schema.text: exact bounded latest Manager decision message
proposal_schema.digest: lowercase SHA-256 produced by the Backend digest rule
proposal_schema.managerTurnId: exact latest Manager decision turn id
proposal_schema.status: session status added only in the frontend-safe read model
proposal_schema.implementationMissionId: separate implementation Mission id or null added only in the read model
proposal_schema.readyToExecute: Backend-derived boolean added only in the read model

proposal_digest.canonicalization: SHA-256 over newline-joined UTF-8 parts: domain separator interactive-meeting-proposal-v2, exact meeting id, exact Manager turn id, exact Manager decision message, compact sorted ensure_ascii=false JSON for structuredDecision, exact agenda, exact developmentGoal, then exact aiTurnsPerRound. Persisted v1 proposals remain verifiable only through the explicit legacy path.
proposal_digest.mutationRule: Changing any bound field creates a new digest, invalidates every earlier approval, and requires a fresh explicit local-user approval.
proposal_digest.reuseRule: An approval for an earlier digest or meeting id is never reusable.

approval_request_schema.note: optional local-user implementation boundary, 1-1200 characters; when present it is secret-checked, persisted in the Mission approval decision, and included in the Mission payload digest

implementation_mission_binding.runnerApprovalBinding: The two CLI values must equal the Backend-verified meetingApprovalBinding values on the exact approved Mission.
implementation_mission_binding.executionGate: Backend rechecks the current proposal digest, complete unused Mission approval, Risk Guard policy, and Mission payload digest before selecting approved_workspace.
implementation_mission_binding.postApprovalState: The session becomes approved and the separate Mission remains waiting_approval with complete approval and readyToExecute=true. Approval never executes inline.
implementation_mission_binding.executionTrigger: A fresh explicit POST /api/missions/:id/execute body confirming that exact Mission id is required; no normal worker or meeting endpoint auto-executes it.

chat_first_legacy_compatibility.scope: Only pre-chat-first stored sessions or explicitly recognized unversioned legacy clients may receive defaults; the current UI must send explicit fields.
chat_first_legacy_compatibility.missingDevelopmentGoalDefault: Use the bounded stored agenda without changing the agenda.
chat_first_legacy_compatibility.missingAiTurnsPerRoundDefault: Use the normalized legacy participantAgentIds count including Manager, clamped from two through four.

implementation_guardrails.writeBoundaryEnforcement: Only a fresh digest-bound approved_workspace Mission exposes the listed project-code writeRoots. Generic auto_guarded Missions retain their narrower workspace/frontend/docs/assets-source allowlist.
implementation_guardrails.readBoundaryEnforcement: Runner instructions forbid reading or enumerating deniedRuntimeAndRepositoryRoots; this is not represented as a separate OS read ACL.
implementation_guardrails.deleteRenameEnforcement: Runner instructions forbid deleting files or moving/renaming existing files inside allowed write roots; this is not a separate filesystem delete ACL.
forbidden: Native Web Search or direct command network
Browser GUI, Computer Use, MCP, Plugin, or external apps
live trading, broker actions, or MT4/MT5 access
secret, credential, auth, cookie, or runtime-data access
scope expansion beyond the frozen proposal

legacy.rule: Scheduled collaboration remains tool-free and cannot propose, approve, or create an implementation Mission through transcript text.

frontend_rule: Dialogue and decisions may be rendered interactively, but Backend session, proposal digest, approval event, separate Mission, report, and audit records are the only durable truth.
